chunk:
deviations: |
  No dominant cross-vendor standard for construction quote / estimate records. Field naming derived from:
    - Salesforce Quote + Quote Line Item standard objects
    - ComputerEase budget worksheet entity (downstream consumer)
    - Construction industry estimating norms (line-item-by-material)

description: |
  Canonical quote entity for construction / specialty-contractor integrations.
  Maps from: CRM (Salesforce Quote + Quote Line Item), estimating tools (PlanSwift, On-Screen Takeoff).
  Maps to:   construction ERP (ComputerEase budget worksheet), contract documents (299A, 299B, HS-118).
  Common synonyms: Quote (Salesforce, generic), Estimate (estimating tools), Proposal (informal).

  Peerless-specific: 'Save as Final' status transition is the canonical downstream-automation trigger
  (UC2). Quote Line Item product bundle is the canonical source for picket-type / material-type rules
  (Venkat B 2026-04-15: 'this data is all available within the Salesforce... only these things should
  come with respect to the woods'). No Excel sheets needed.

required:
  - quoteId
  - customerId
  - status
  - lines
  - totals
  - timestamps

properties:
  quoteId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical quote identifier
    example: "QTE-2026-000565"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    properties:
      salesforceQuoteId:   { type: string, description: "Salesforce Quote 18-char ID" }
      portalQuoteId:       { type: string, description: "Quote/estimate ID at originating portal" }

  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-customer

  leadId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-lead (the originating lead)

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [DRAFT, SENT, ACCEPTED, FINAL, REJECTED, EXPIRED, CONVERTED]
    description: 'FINAL state ("Save as Final" in Salesforce) is the trigger for downstream automation'

  finalizedAt:
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: Timestamp when quote transitioned to FINAL — triggers UC2 + UC3

  lines:
    type: array
    description: Line items — picket-type / material / labor / subcontract
    items:
      type: object
      required: [lineNumber, sku, materialType, quantity, unitPrice]
      properties:
        lineNumber:     { type: integer }
        sku:            { type: string, description: "Product / material SKU" }
        description:    { type: string }
        materialType:   { type: string, description: "Picket / material category derived from product bundle (e.g. 'cedar' → wood)" }
        quantity:       { type: number }
        unit:           { type: string, description: "ft, sqft, each, etc." }

stubNote: |
  Created from peerless engagement 2026-05-22 by Rex. UC2 trigger = quote status FINAL. UC3 validates
  picket-type / material rules from lines[].materialType + serviceAddress.state (Wisconsin 99% deposit
  rule) + signedDate (Friday rule) + permitRequired (single-value rule). Fields to finalize during
  Analyst PRD: Salesforce Quote Line Item product-bundle to materialType mapping rules, line.category
  thresholds for subcontract-write decisions (UC6-potential), commission worksheet field mapping.
